# Smoke UI tests for pull requests and pushes to main.
# CI runs all PigeonReaderTests plus only these UI tests; nightly, on-demand
# full runs, and TestFlight releases run every UI test.
#
# One xcodebuild -only-testing identifier per line: Target/Class/testMethod.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. CI fails if an entry no
# longer matches a test method in ios/PigeonReader/PigeonReaderUITests, or if
# xcodebuild does not report every entry as run. Rename or remove a test here
# in the same change that renames or removes it in Swift.
